name: Stitchflesh Abominations
summary: Attacks against your Haemonculus Covens units suffer -1 to the wound roll whenever the attacker's Strength exceeds that unit's Toughness.

name: Exacting Cruelty
summary: Wych Cult units' melee attacks gain Lethal Hits against non-Monster, non-Vehicle targets. This detachment cannot be combined with another Wych Cult detachment.

name: Contracted Harvest
summary: Friendly Blades for Hire and Kabal units' ranged attacks gain Sustained Hits 1 against non-Monster, non-Vehicle targets. Exclusive Kabal-tagged detachment.

name: Murderous Agenda
summary: At the start of battle pick a Contract and a matching enemy unit: Kabal and Blades for Hire get Precision on it, or Sustained Hits 1 versus all Infantry/Mounted, or Lethal Hits versus all Monsters/Vehicles. Killing it pays 3 Pain tokens.

name: Alliance of Agony
summary: At battle start, gain 2 Pain tokens for each qualifying character-and-unit-type pairing in your army (Archon/Kabalite Warriors, Succubus/Wyches, Haemonculus/Wracks), stacking up to 6.

name: Callous Competition
summary: Drukhari start winning the wager; each kill flips it to the killer. Winners re-roll Hit rolls of 1, losers re-roll Hit and Wound rolls of 1. Take up to 500/1000/1500 pts of Harlequins, never Warlord; no Corsairs and Travelling Players.

name: Rain Of Cruelty
summary: Whenever a Drukhari unit disembarks from a Transport, its ranged weapons gain Ignores Cover and its melee weapons gain Lance until end of turn.

name: Combat Drugs
summary: At the start of your Command phase take one Combat Drug, no repeats, or roll 2D6 for two; until your next Command phase Wych Cult models get +1 melee Attacks, +2" Move, +1 melee WS, +1 Toughness, +1 melee Strength, or +1 Ld and ranged BS.

name: Darkest Artifice
summary: Attacks against friendly Cronos or Talos units from a higher-Strength attacker get -1 to wound. Exclusive Covens-tagged detachment.
